title: Israel's president tasks Gadi Eisenkot, not Netanyahu, with forming the next government
detail: Per Al Jazeera and Le Monde reports of November 7, 2026, Israel's president chose opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot over Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to attempt to form the next government following the recent election. Only headline-level details were available; coalition arithmetic should be checked against full reports.

media.caption: Israel's president picks Eisenkot over Netanyahu to form next government
